name: Signature Cable
old_description: Since 2002, Signature Cable has met its customers’ demands with high reliability and quality conformance due to its effective manufacturing techniques, skilled personnel, state-of-the-art equipment. Signature Cable does not impose an annual minimum spend upon its customers. We will build one cable and accept a credit card or build thousands of cables on payment terms. Our sweet spot tends to be High Mix/Low to Medium Volume and all customers are treated equally. We also offer R&D support, build quick turn prototypes in twenty four to forty eight hours (provided material is available), and if local we have even delivered in urgent situations.
about:
Signature Cable, Inc. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Cranston, Rhode Island. The company operates a domestic manufacturing facility in Rhode Island, about 10 minutes from Providence, and also partners with suppliers in Hong Kong and China.

The company specializes in molded cables, custom wire and cable harnesses, and electro-mechanical box build assemblies for original equipment manufacturers. It offers full production capabilities including wire harness production, cable assemblies, molded cable assemblies, prototyping, engineering, and R&D support. Signature Cable focuses on high-mix, low-to-medium volume production with no minimum annual spend or order size, and can deliver quick-turn prototypes in 24 to 48 hours when materials are available.

Its customer base spans the military, medical, industrial, aerospace, security, transportation, semiconductor, automation, and homeland security sectors. The company serves OEMs across these industries, building everything from single cables to thousands of units on payment terms.

Signature Cable differentiates itself through its ISO 9001:2015 certification, UL and Canadian UL listings, RoHS compliance, and adherence to IPC 610/620 Class I, II, and III standards as well as MIL-STD-45662. The company emphasizes competitive pricing, low overhead, fast turnaround times, a newly implemented ERP system, and lean manufacturing practices such as 5S to drive efficiency and cost savings.
